roles.title: Backend, Runo (CRM SaaS)
bullets: Delivered the standalone AI Call Analysis API across six repositories, shaping its request contract with product, frontend and AI teams and adding secure-link, duration-limit and result-delivery handling.
Designed the DynamoDB storage layout and APIs for an hourly and daily usage page; followed launch with seven usage-write fixes over four days.
Delivered Lead Intelligence across eight repositories, including filters, report columns, permissions and AI-credit billing; the feature released in v8.2.

Designed shared location-filter logic across customer pages and reports, added customer API indexes, and shared the measured latency with the tech lead; the values were not recorded in the work history.

roles.title: Associate Consultant, Invincix Solutions
bullets: Delivered features and releases for a subscription milk-delivery app serving {{users_invincix}} active users, by building and maintaining Node.js REST APIs and the Flutter client.
Integrated Razorpay, Cashfree and Easebuzz, by building webhook handling with signature verification and payment reconciliation flows.
Cut API response time by {{latency_cut}}, by optimizing queries, adding response caching and reducing parsing overhead.
Enabled verifiable deliveries, by building GPS tracking, driver validation and EXIF timestamp verification.
